title: Place-names before the deeds

cast.D_BILLY: the Grandson (2020s, 40s); invented face (cast/D_BILLY.jpg) - never the likeness of any real family member

shots.direction: Title card held over a slow push-in on a closed archive box under a reading lamp; the title 'CEDWYN' and 'A tab.bot production' are added in post.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up of a plain grey archive box and a pair of white cotton gloves on a dark wooden reading-room table, single warm lamp, soft dust in the light, deep shadows, modern records office, shallow depth of field, no people, no text, no heraldry

shots.direction: HOOK (after the title card, 0-5 s of speech): talking close-up of Nia, gloved, a single note card in her hand.

lines.en: Before any deed, there was a name. Whose name, and whose hill?
lines.cy: Cyn unrhyw weithred, roedd enw. Enw pwy, a bryn pwy?
lines.es: Antes de cualquier escritura, había un nombre. ¿El nombre de quién, y la colina de quién?

shots.direction: Wide establishing shot of the archive reading room; Nia pulls on cotton gloves and slides a stack of folders across to the Grandson, who sits down with his laptop. [27 Oct rule: narrators speak ON CAMERA, lip-synced; any document is a HyperFrames cutaway/overlay between talking shots, never a still under the voice.]
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal modern county records office reading room, long wooden tables, grey archive boxes on steel shelving, tall windows with soft overcast Welsh daylight; a Welsh woman in her 30s with a black bob haircut, round tortoiseshell glasses, mustard cardigan and white cotton gloves lays out folders; opposite her a man in his 40s with dark curly hair, blue eyes, short beard and a waxed jacket opens a laptop beside paper folders; no text, no heraldry

lines.en: Bore da. Gloves on before you touch anything. Before a single deed, we've got names. Just names, written in your family's research notes.
lines.cy: Bore da. Menig ymlaen cyn i chi gyffwrdd dim byd. Cyn unrhyw weithred, mae gyda ni enwau. Dim ond enwau, wedi'u hysgrifennu yn nodiadau ymchwil eich teulu.
lines.es: Bore da. Guantes puestos antes de tocar nada. Antes de cualquier escritura, tenemos nombres. Solo nombres, escritos en las notas de investigación de tu familia.

lines.en: Cedwyn. That's the word I keep tripping over. Cedwyn, Cwm-Cedwyn, Nant-Cedwyn, Ynys-Cedwyn. Then Cedfin, Cydfin, Cydwin. And Tŷ Mawr, the Great House.
lines.cy: Cedwyn. Dyna'r gair dwi'n baglu drosto o hyd. Cedwyn, Cwm-Cedwyn, Nant-Cedwyn, Ynys-Cedwyn. Wedyn Cedfin, Cydfin, Cydwin. A Tŷ Mawr, y 'Great House'.
lines.es: Cedwyn. Esa es la palabra con la que tropiezo. Cedwyn, Cwm-Cedwyn, Nant-Cedwyn, Ynys-Cedwyn. Luego Cedfin, Cydfin, Cydwin. Y Tŷ Mawr, la Casa Grande.

shots.omnihuman_split: one talking shot per speaker (D_BILLY, I_NIA); OmniHuman drives one face per render

shots.direction: Overhead insert: Nia's gloved finger runs down a printed index sheet laid on the table. [27 Oct rule: narrators speak ON CAMERA, lip-synced; any document is a HyperFrames cutaway/overlay between talking shots, never a still under the voice.]
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal overhead view of a printed research index sheet with typed columns and handwritten pencil ticks, a gloved hand pointing down the rows, wooden table, reading lamp light, text on the sheet blurred and illegible, no heraldry
shots.document: EV-0195 Cedwyn / Cwm-Cedwyn place-name notes: reference index and dependency register (GHF-E174 to GHF-E179)

lines.en: This is the index. Six research leads. It shows where each name turns up, and which notes lean on which. Pull one out, you see what wobbles.
lines.cy: Dyma'r mynegai. Chwe trywydd ymchwil. Mae'n dangos ble mae pob enw'n codi, a pha nodiadau sy'n dibynnu ar bwy. Tynnwch un allan, chi'n gweld beth sy'n simsanu.
lines.es: Este es el índice. Seis pistas de investigación. Muestra dónde aparece cada nombre, y qué notas se apoyan en cuáles. Si sacas una, ves qué se tambalea.

shots.direction: Close-up on the Grandson, leaning in, hopeful.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up portrait of a Welsh man in his 40s, dark curly hair, blue eyes, short beard, waxed jacket, lit by a warm reading lamp in an archive reading room, folders blurred in the background, no text, no heraldry

lines.en: So does it prove the Great House stood on Cedwyn land? That my family's roots there go back before any deed?
lines.cy: Felly ydy e'n profi fod y Tŷ Mawr wedi sefyll ar dir Cedwyn? Bod gwreiddiau fy nheulu yno'n mynd 'nôl cyn unrhyw weithred?
lines.es: ¿Entonces esto prueba que la Casa Grande se encontraba en tierras de Cedwyn? ¿Que las raíces de mi familia allí se remontan a antes de cualquier escritura?

shots.direction: Close-up on Nia, gentle but firm, taking off her glasses.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up portrait of a Welsh woman in her 30s, black bob haircut, round tortoiseshell glasses held in a cotton-gloved hand, mustard cardigan, archive shelving softly blurred behind, warm lamp light, no text, no heraldry

lines.en: Not on its own. It proves the leads are catalogued. Whether the variants are one place, whether they mean Tŷ Mawr, and what any old lease meant for the land after 1877: those are the next checks.
lines.cy: Dim ar ei ben ei hun. Mae'n profi bod y trywyddion wedi'u catalogio. P'un a yw'r amrywiadau'n un lle, p'un a ydyn nhw'n golygu Tŷ Mawr, a beth oedd ystyr unrhyw hen brydles i'r tir ar ôl 1877: dyna'r pethau nesaf i'w gwirio.
lines.es: No por sí sola. Prueba que las pistas están catalogadas. Si las variantes son un mismo lugar, si significan Tŷ Mawr, y qué implicó algún arrendamiento antiguo para la tierra después de 1877: esas son las próximas verificaciones.

shots.direction: Insert: the Grandson lays a typed note card beside an unmarked sketch of a river bend. [27 Oct rule: narrators speak ON CAMERA, lip-synced; any document is a HyperFrames cutaway/overlay between talking shots, never a still under the voice.]
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up of a typed index card and a pencil sketch of a river bend among trees on tracing paper, on a wooden archive table, lettering blurred and illegible, reading lamp light, no heraldry
shots.document: EV-0200 Place-name note: Cwm-Cedwyn, wooded dell on the Ely between Leckwith and Llandough

lines.en: Cwm-Cedwyn. A wooded dell on the Ely, between Leckwith and Llandough. My notes use it all the time.
lines.cy: Cwm-Cedwyn. Pant coediog ar lan afon Elái, rhwng Lecwydd a Llandochau. Mae fy nodiadau i'n ei ddefnyddio o hyd.
lines.es: Cwm-Cedwyn. Un valle boscoso sobre el Ely, entre Leckwith y Llandough. Mis notas lo usan todo el tiempo.

lines.en: They do. But there's no source attached yet. We don't know when the name was first written, where its edges ran, or whether it ever touched Tŷ Mawr. Checking is still to do.
lines.cy: Odyn, glei. Ond sdim ffynhonnell ynghlwm wrtho eto. Sa i'n gwybod pryd gafodd yr enw ei ysgrifennu gyntaf, lle roedd ei ffiniau'n rhedeg, na p'un a oedd e byth yn cyffwrdd â Thŷ Mawr. Mae'r gwirio i'w wneud o hyd.
lines.es: Así es. Pero todavía no hay una fuente adjunta. No sabemos cuándo se escribió el nombre por primera vez, dónde estaban sus límites, ni si alguna vez tuvo relación con Tŷ Mawr. Aún queda por verificar.

shots.direction: Slow drift through Leckwith woods down to the River Ely in morning mist, birdsong, no people.

shots.direction: Insert: an empty labelled folder sleeve, nothing inside, held up to the lamp. [27 Oct rule: narrators speak ON CAMERA, lip-synced; any document is a HyperFrames cutaway/overlay between talking shots, never a still under the voice.]

shots.document: EV-0198 Nant-Cedwyn: place-name note for a brook near Leckwith/Llandough (primary document not yet held)

lines.en: And Nant-Cedwyn. A brook running into the Ely near Leckwith.
lines.cy: A Nant-Cedwyn. Nant sy'n llifo i'r Elái ger Lecwydd.
lines.es: Y Nant-Cedwyn. Un arroyo que desemboca en el Ely cerca de Leckwith.

lines.en: That one points to a primary document, and we haven't got it yet. So for now it shows us one thing: the family noted the name. Name, place, date, link to Tŷ Mawr: all still to be checked.
lines.cy: Mae hwnna'n pwyntio at ddogfen wreiddiol, a sdim gyda ni eto. Felly am nawr mae'n dangos un peth i ni: bod y teulu wedi nodi'r enw. Enw, lle, dyddiad, cyswllt â Thŷ Mawr: mae pob un yn dal i fod angen ei wirio.
lines.es: Ese dato señala un documento primario, y todavía no lo tenemos. Así que por ahora nos muestra una sola cosa: la familia anotó el nombre. Nombre, lugar, fecha, vínculo con Tŷ Mawr: todo sigue pendiente de verificación.

shots.document: EV-0210 Ynys-Cedwyn: place-name associated with Cedwyn Gawr (research note)

lines.es: La rara del grupo es Ynys-Cedwyn.

lines.en: Ynys-Cedwyn sits up where the Twrch meets the Tawe, a long way from here. The note ties it to Cedwyn Gawr, Cedwyn the Giant.
lines.cy: Mae Ynys-Cedwyn i fyny lle mae'r Twrch yn cwrdd â'r Tawe, ymhell o fan hyn. Mae'r nodyn yn ei gysylltu â Cedwyn Gawr, Cedwyn y Cawr.
lines.es: Ynys-Cedwyn está donde el Twrch se une al Tawe, bien lejos de aquí. La nota lo liga a Cedwyn Gawr, Cedwyn el Gigante.

shots.omnihuman_split: one talking shot per speaker (D_BILLY, I_NIA); OmniHuman drives one face per render

shots.direction: Close-up on the Grandson, amused, half a laugh.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up of a Welsh man in his 40s, dark curly hair, blue eyes, short beard, waxed jacket, wry smile, archive reading room behind him softly blurred, warm lamp light, no text, no heraldry

lines.en: A giant. Lovely. Is there anything linking him to Llandough?
lines.cy: Cawr. Hyfryd. Oes unrhyw beth yn ei gysylltu e â Llandochau?
lines.es: Un gigante. Qué lindo. ¿Hay algo que lo conecte con Llandough?

shots.direction: Close-up on Nia, tapping the card once.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up of a Welsh woman in her 30s, black bob haircut, round tortoiseshell glasses, mustard cardigan, cotton-gloved finger resting on an index card, archive reading room, warm lamp light, no text, no heraldry

lines.en: Not yet. No primary source, the place and the giant both waiting to be checked, and no link to Tŷ Mawr written down.
lines.cy: Dim eto. Sdim ffynhonnell wreiddiol, mae'r lle a'r cawr ill dau'n aros i gael eu gwirio, a sdim cyswllt â Thŷ Mawr wedi'i gofnodi.
lines.es: Todavía no. No hay fuente primaria, el lugar y el gigante aún esperan ser verificados, y no hay ningún vínculo con Tŷ Mawr registrado por escrito.

shots.direction: Two-shot: the Grandson closes his laptop, Nia gathers the cards into one pile; the window light shifts toward the hills outside. [27 Oct rule: narrators speak ON CAMERA, lip-synced; any document is a HyperFrames cutaway/overlay between talking shots, never a still under the voice.]
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal two-shot in a modern archive reading room: a Welsh woman in her 30s with black bob, tortoiseshell glasses, mustard cardigan and cotton gloves stacking index cards; a man in his 40s with dark curly hair, short beard and waxed jacket closing a laptop; tall window behind showing green hills under grey sky, no text, no heraldry

lines.en: So the film starts with a name we can't pin down.
lines.cy: Felly mae'r ffilm yn dechrau gydag enw dy'n ni ddim yn gallu ei bennu.
lines.es: Entonces la película empieza con un nombre que no podemos ubicar.

lines.en: It starts honest. A name, and a hill that came before it. Let's go and stand on the hill.
lines.cy: Mae'n dechrau'n onest. Enw, a bryn oedd yno o'i flaen. Dewch i ni fynd i sefyll ar y bryn.
lines.es: Empieza con honestidad. Un nombre, y una colina que vino antes. Vamos a pararnos en la colina.
